setup.title: Instagram Setup Guide
setup.intro: Connect your Instagram Professional account to Hay.chat. Once connected, direct messages sent to your account are routed through Hay.chat's AI, and replies are delivered straight back to the Instagram thread.

step1.title: Connect your Instagram account
step1.body: Click the Connect button above to sign in with Facebook Login for Business. Choose the Facebook Page and the linked Instagram Professional account you want Hay.chat to manage, then approve the requested permissions. Hay.chat stores the connection securely — no tokens to copy or paste.
step1.hint: You need an Instagram Professional account (Business or Creator) that is linked to a Facebook Page you manage.

step2.title: Photos, videos and voice messages
step2.body: Hay.chat keeps the photos, videos, voice messages and files shoppers send, and transcribes voice messages so the AI can answer them. Story mentions, reels and shared posts show as a short note. Reactions are not shown. Your team and the AI can send photos, videos, audio and PDFs back.

step3.title: Replies after 24 hours
step3.body: Instagram allows a free-form reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message. After that, a reply written by a person on your team is still sent for up to 7 days. The AI only replies within the 24 hours.

step4.title: Where messages appear
step4.body: Once connected, new Instagram DMs show up as conversations in your Hay.chat inbox. The AI agent assigned to the Instagram channel responds automatically.
step4.hint: To assign an agent, go to Settings → Channels and select an agent for the Instagram channel.

setup.windowNote: Messaging window: the AI can reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message. A person on your team can reply for up to 7 days. After that, wait for the customer to write again.
